definitions.explanation: something made by hand rather than by machine; often implies care, personal touch, or authenticity

⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手作|てづく}り⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + {作|つく}り (making) → made by hand

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手作|てづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: handmade [noun]
- {手作|てづく}り⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (handmade feel/quality)

USAGE:
{手作|てづく}り carries positive connotations of care, effort, and authenticity. It's often used to emphasize the personal touch or traditional craftsmanship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手作|てづく}り⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (home-cooked meal)
- {手作|てづく}り⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (homemade bento)
- {手作|てづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧ (homemade sweets)
- {手作|てづく}り⟦{雑貨|ざっか}→雑貨：10008_zakka⟧ (handmade goods)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既製品|きせいひん}→既製品：08304_kiseihin⟧ (ready-made product) - opposite concept
